explication: This repository is a curated collection of data-science and machine-learning notebook examples, rather than one application with a single end-to-end workflow. The typical user workflow is to explore a topic-specific example, prepare or load data, run an analysis or model, and inspect predictions or visualizations. The graph preserves the major documented deep-learning and analysis areas and substantial sampled modules. Source excerpts are selective; edges are limited to relationships evidenced by the README or SOURCE INDEX, so unsampled tutorial branches have no inferred runtime wiring.
